Each returns through Starting once its cause has cleared; the AC's 3-minute restart delay is respected.

Normal load: AC on; its setpoint (whole degrees) is trimmed so that the 10-minute average intake
meets the target - the AC's own thermostat cycles the compressor. Low load (the servers warm the
air by less than 4 K): eco pulls the rack down to target - 2, switches the AC off and back on at
target + 2 or a hot side of 32. Unknown readings or over-temperature always mean AC on.
no reading on the cold or the hot side
dew point 1 K over supply air for 10 min
off, but intake hit the warning
no screen heartbeat 60 s / node not answering
average of the cold side the AC is trimmed to
ASHRAE A1 recommended max / hard limit
AC off at low load: rise across the servers < 4 K
off when pulled down, on again when warm (or hot side 32)
first guess target + 3, trimmed in whole degrees
on the mean error over the window
cold side above the limit before K1 closes

1 Bench: power the carrier from 12 V with U1 out: +5 V, +12 V on J2. Fit U1: +3V3.
2 Flash both boards over USB-C (esphome run ...); 'Rack link' turns green.
3 Probes: the node log lists every DS18B20 per bus at boot. Warm one at a time in
your hand, put each address in sra16-node.yaml, re-flash.
4 AC protocol: point the AC remote at the node box lid: the log says 'Received
5 Press 'Re-send to AC' on the Alarms screen: the AC must go to cool at the setpoint
shown. Try OFF and back to AUTO. Stick the emitter where this always works.
6 Doors and float: open / lift each; its dot turns amber. Backwards? add
7 Unplug a probe lead: 'probe missing', 3 beeps a minute, AC kept on.
8 Shutdown: set the limit to 28, warm T1 and T2: K1 closes 120 s later. Only
then wire J3 to the UPS / server input. Reset with 'Reset alarms'.
9 Leave it a day: the cold-side average should sit at the target.
Lines: hot side (red), cold side (blue), AC supply and return.
Blue band: compressor running; grey: AC off; triangles: IR
frames sent; red: alarms. tools/sim_controller.py compiles
sra_control.h for the PC and runs it against a lumped model of
the rack and the AC - thermostat and restart delay included.
